question: Who among the following wrote the book 'Parvat Shiromani Bhagat Singh Koshyari'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madan Mohan Sat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Madan Mohan Sat** is the author of the book **'Parvat Shiromani Bhagat Singh Koshyari'**, which is a tribute to the contributions of Bhagat Singh Koshyari.
 
• The book highlights the life, ideologies, and achievements of **Bhagat Singh Koshyari**, who is known for his significant contributions in Indian politics and public service.
 
• Bhagat Singh Koshyari has served as the **Governor of Maharashtra** and has held various key political positions in India.
 
• The book delves into his journey as a leader and his commitment to the upliftment of society, especially in the state of **Uttarakhand**.
 
• 'Parvat Shiromani Bhagat Singh Koshyari' is recognized as a work that sheds light on the personal and professional life of one of India's notable political figures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhagat Singh Koshyari:**

 
 
• He is an Indian politician who has held various positions, including **Chief Minister of Uttarakhand** and **Governor of Maharashtra**.
 
• Koshyari has been associated with the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** and is considered a prominent leader from the state of Uttarakhand.
 
• He has contributed to the development of Uttarakhand and is known for his grassroots-level initiatives.
 
 
 
• **Uttarakhand's Political Landscape:**
 
 
• Uttarakhand, also referred to as the **'Land of the Gods'**, has seen leaders like Bhagat Singh Koshyari play pivotal roles in its development post its formation in 2000.
 
• The state is known for its cultural and geographical diversity, which has influenced its political and social policies.
 
 
 
• **Books on Political Leaders:**
 
 
• Books like 'Parvat Shiromani Bhagat Singh Koshyari' serve as important resources for understanding the lives and ideologies of political figures.
 
• Such works often provide insights into the challenges and milestones faced by leaders during their tenure.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Documenting Political Contributions:**
 
 
• Documenting the lives of leaders like Bhagat Singh Koshyari helps preserve history and offers guidance for future generations.
 
• It also brings to light the socio-political impact of their work on regional and national levels.
